variants.name: 环冠
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE new, polished HARP-BOW weapon design. The attached image is only a reference for the weapon's distinctive broad, ornate, openwork upper limb and integrated multiple musical strings. It is not an edit target. Do not depict the character, quiver, arrow, costume, green/gold color scheme, or dark screenshot setting.

Subject: a coherent hybrid of an archery bow and a harp, with wide asymmetric upper architecture, large negative-space harp window, narrower tapering lower limb, and a clearly accessible central wrapped handgrip. The musical frame must be an integral part of the bow, not a separate small instrument attached as decoration. There are five or six clearly separated taut musical strings, each visibly anchored at both ends to structural bridges. ONE distinct main bowstring connects the two outer bowtips directly, straight and undrawn, without intersecting the grip or body.

Style: Heaven Burns Red (HBR)-inspired anime science-fiction armament concept art. Elegant advanced ceramic armor, precise silver-white metal joints, selected faceted crystal inserts, restrained pale-blue energy accents, crisp fine outlines, delicate cel shading and controlled reflective highlights. Pink and sky blue should be visible as broad clean color areas, not only tiny accents. Avoid excessive random small shards and heavy purple shadows.
Palette: balanced cherry-blossom pink and clear sky blue, cool silver-white support frame, small blue-gray grip wrapping. No dominant purple, gold, green, or red-black.

Composition: one entire isolated weapon, pure white background, portrait 2:3, upright clear side view, main string on the right, complete tip-to-tip silhouette with generous margins. Place the actual grippable wrapped handle at the image's VERTICAL MIDPOINT, horizontally aligned with the midpoint of the main bowstring. Upper and lower tips equally far above and below grip. Keep the musical-string lower bridge ABOVE the grip level unless the variant explicitly calls for full-span strings. Do not move the handle down to accommodate the harp; reshape the upper frame instead. Free finger clearance and plausible solid connections. No character, hand, arrow, quiver, text, labels, diagrams, watermark, or multiple views.
This is a genuinely different variant in a new series, not a minor recolor. Specific design: Broad upper limb built from two concentric open oval arcs with a small interruption bridged by visible silver struts; soft pink outer arc and blue inner arc. Five straight parallel musical strings occupy the upper oval window, connected to a stepped transverse bridge above the central handgrip. The upper tip grows elegantly from the outer oval and the lower limb is a slender double-curved taper. No detached circular halo.
